subject: Help: folder not visible when splitting UI and server code in to several files.

messages.author: 7901007eb73d739a
messages.subject: Help: folder not visible when splitting UI and server code in to several files.
parts:
Hi,

I'm trying to deploy my app (code is here and the app is https://tcgabiolinksgui.shinyapps.io/tcgabiolinks/), but I have some problems.

I added the server code in server folder and the ui code in ui folder. Apparently, the ui folder is visible, but not the server folder.

I'm using Rstudio to publish the files in shinyapps.io and both server and ui folders are checked to be included in the push.

The log says:  cannot open file 'server/getmolecular.R': No such file or directory.

Please, could someone help me? 
I had the same problem for the UI, but I changed the code to look in the ui folder and it worked. But it is not working for the server.

Thanks.

Best regards,
Tiago Chedraoui Silva
